investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: An Azure Network Security Group (nsg-prod-db-cluster) in the production resource group rg-baltic-prod-data was modified to add an inbound rule Allow_LB_HealthCheck_Internal permitting source '*' to destination 10.0.5.2:443. The change was performed by aleksei.ivanov@globalcorp.ee (IAM role: Owner) from an IP geolocated to Tallinn at 23:15 EET and the operation succeeded. Although the rule description indicates a routine load balancer health probe, the modification targets a production environment, uses a wildcard source address, was made outside normal working hours, and the actor's job title (Senior Software Developer) does not clearly align with infrastructure administration, while there are no recent related deployment events; these factors increase risk and justify escalation for further review.
